description: For mlab, parse(text)=Err implies no statement/function-registration effects; otherwise Interp registers functions and dispatches tree or VM. VM compile produces prototypes, imports workspace, executes native instructions with tree fallback/dynamic synchronization, then exports workspace even on returned runtime error. suite.parse produces Scenario(code,expect); run_fs executes each in a new interpreter/FS then check(expect,captured_output). vm_gate compares fresh tree/VM outputs, stops first differing scenario. Independent tagged relation layers.route(q,C): normalize explanation phrases for exact global math; otherwise stable finite-score descending domain attempts at score>=threshold under a finite threshold; otherwise Escalate value.

Interp::run calls vm::run_program only after registration; VM Fallback invokes Interp::exec and DynEval invokes eval_multi through sync_out/sync_in. lib.rs exposes item identities consumed by tests. suite::run_fs consumes parser scenarios and feeds captured output to check; vm_gate compares engines independently of expected answers, so shared broken builtins can pass equivalence. layers/lib.rs is a separate tagged routing relation to math/global and Domain callbacks, with no mlab caller/callee edge; grouping does not imply runtime transport.

Wave31 child virtual-filesystem-state: Actual callers: mlab/src/interp.rs owns Box<dyn vfs::FileSystem>, mlab/src/builtins/files.rs and table.rs call it; open selects backend. Memory path->error->journal joins tested. wasi-host is sibling consumer of Vfs/Errno projections, not owned here. snapbench and test fixtures are independent observation paths, not production callers.

Wave31 child wasi-guest-runtime: Real join: Ctx::path_open resolves through Vfs, allocates descriptor; fd_write/read use canonical stored path and Vfs::write_at/read_at, with Vfs errno and journal propagation. Tests observe holes/append/read-only/limits/escape effects. main constructs Ctx from imported Vfs, Host::run returns same context for gated exports. Tagged independent paths: example mlab_gate and tests/mlab compare external mlab::Interp to Host, neither is called by main. Memory-unit tests bypass add_wasi ABI wrappers; tiny guests have no imports, so complete linker wiring is not claimed.
inverse: Parse failure excludes prefix effects; short-circuit false&&/true|| excludes RHS calls; invalid fast indices exclude direct writes; mismatch excludes remaining gate scenarios. Global math success excludes domain callbacks; finite below-threshold score excludes solve. Equivalent engine output does not exclude shared bugs.

Preimage of (captured bytes,final workspace) contains all source/initial-state/fault triples yielding those observations; suppressed writes and overwritten locals make it many-to-one. Scenario parsing drops ignored text and trailing blank code, so inverse is set-valued. A route value admits many queries and declining-domain histories; Domain may supply arbitrary Answer.by.
limitations: Finite synthetic evidence does not prove arbitrary tree/VM equivalence or absolute correctness.
Frozen suites and recursion-heavy EDGE are compiled but not executed; library reexports have no standalone runtime control.
Control mutants change assertions, not production algorithms; no claim of complete mutation coverage.
No supported executable percentage surrogate for categorical execution/effect relations; no speed or approximation-error claim.
Nonfinite domain scores, raw bytecode, allocation failures and unbounded loops remain explicit gaps.
state: The admitted synthetic programs preserve tree/VM expected output, prefix state on runtime error, no prefix state on parse error, matrix alias independence and short-circuit effects. Fresh suite scenarios do not share default workspace/FS. Gate line offsets are1-based and totals count visited prefix. Finite equal routing scores preserve registration order, global math precedes scoring. These are source-derived and finitely checked relations, not universal proofs.
